items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: He played with Claven Williams. And Claven couldn't see him. He was going to see Claven's daughter.

ctx.x: Now who is Bolegs? What did he do? Good.

Good drummer. Yeah, he died, died here. Who did he play with? Oh, he played with the best when he was down here. He played with Claven Williams. And Claven couldn't see him. He was going to see Claven's daughter. But that family couldn't see him because he's an ugly guy, you know. Figured that his daughter was too much. Was he dark or had bad hair or what? He was dark as my shoe. I had a good place who got done my drum. So Claven didn't agree for him to marry his daughter. Marry his daughter. That's right. That's…
